project_fields.Objective: Govern fleet concurrency and reclaim leaked resources

source_artifact.content_excerpt: Five mechanisms against one disease (15 stale worktrees, missing Step B8): the contract (F2-1), the ledger it executes against (F4-1), the time-based backstop for what the contract misses (F5-1 TTL reaper, F6-2 idle-TTL eviction of resident teammates), and the invariant that keeps it honest (F6-8 CI leak check). Contract without backstop re-leaks on crash; backstop without contract normalizes leaking -- they are one deliverable.
source_artifact.title: Non-skippable teardown: Step B8 run-exit Teardown & Reclaim contract, register-on-spawn reclamation ledger, TTL worktree reaper, idle-TTL eviction, and a CI leak invariant
